intro.text: A sergeant of the reserves in Highmarshal Amaram's army.

items.text: Dalar assigned newly formed squads from the reserves to replace those that had been lost. Tien was placed in a deep reserve team of untrained messenger boys, which Dalar said would only be used if the army were in serious danger.

In a skirmish with Hallaw's forces, Kaladin realized Tien's reserve team had been sent into combat. Searching frantically, he found Dalar beside a post flying two banners, and Dalar told him Tien was with Brightlord Sheler's company on the southeast side of the hill.

appearance.text: A lanky man with only three fingers on one hand.
